title: Natural module/Ext comparison for the direct-image edge map
statement: For commutative rings R and B in the scheme universe, an R-algebra structure on B, a morphism h:Y -> Spec R and a nonnegative integer p, write X = baseChangedScheme(B,h) and f = baseChangeFst(B,h) [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. There are natural-in-coefficients families of additive equivalences E on Y and E prime on X from module-derived global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology] to the Ext model H [pqf-def-cohomology]. For every F on X and x in module cohomology of f_*F, E prime_F(moduleCohomologyEdgeMap(f,F,p)(x)) [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] is Sheaf.H.map(coeff(f,id),p)(Sheaf.H.mapFunctor(invImage(f),constIso(f).symm, underlying f_*F,p)(E_(f_*F)(x))). Only the identity coefficient map is asserted; arbitrary h-maps and the scalar-extension unit are excluded from this conclusion.

proof.text: Construct the equivalence families on Y and its base change using moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv, whose object data is the concrete normalized common-section-complex comparison. Coefficient naturality on both schemes is moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv_naturality.

Specialize the normalized edge identity to baseChangeFst(B,h), F and x. Assemble the two equivalence families, their naturality proofs and this edge equality using existential introduction and conjunction introduction.

theorem exists_moduleCohomology_ext_edge_comparison
    {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ E : ∀ M : Y.Modules,
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj M) ≃+ H M p,
    ∃ E' : ∀ M : (baseChangedScheme (S := B) h).Modules,
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
        (baseChangedScheme (S := B) h).toRingedSpace p).obj M) ≃+ H M p,
      (∀ (M M' : Y.Modules) (φ : M ⟶ M')
        (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj M),
        E M' (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).map φ).hom x) =
          H.map φ p (E M x)) ∧
      (∀ (M M' : (baseChangedScheme (S := B) h).Modules) (φ : M ⟶ M')
        (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
          (baseChangedScheme (S := B) h).toRingedSpace p).obj M),
        E' M' (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
          (baseChangedScheme (S := B) h).toRingedSpace p).map φ).hom x) =
          H.map φ p (E' M x)) ∧
      (∀ (F : (baseChangedScheme (S := B) h).Modules)
        (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj
          ((pushforward (baseChangeFst (S := B) h)).obj F)),
        E' F (moduleCohomologyEdgeMap (baseChangeFst (S := B) h) F p x) =
          Sheaf.H.map (coeff (baseChangeFst (S := B) h)
            (𝟙 ((pushforward (baseChangeFst (S := B) h)).obj F))) p
            (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage (baseChangeFst (S := B) h))
              (constIso (baseChangeFst (S := B) h)).symm
              ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj
                ((pushforward (baseChangeFst (S := B) h)).obj F)) p
              (E ((pushforward (baseChangeFst (S := B) h)).obj F) x)))
